metacognition_prompt: Before you start, what single skill is this repair problem checking?

error_category_mapping.diagnostic_sentence: If 25 is treated only as two factors, the missing link is square-number notation. Difference of squares work needs you to recognise constants as repeated factors quickly.

hint_ladder.title: Square form
hint_ladder.prompt: Writing 25 as a square means showing one number multiplied by itself, not splitting 25 into any two factors.

hint_ladder.title: Recall square
hint_ladder.prompt: Think of the small square numbers: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25. Which base number gives 25?

hint_ladder.title: Factor vs square
hint_ladder.prompt: Students often give 5 and 5 without writing square notation. The repair is to show the repeated factor as a power.

hint_ladder.title: Square-number routine
hint_ladder.prompt: For a square constant, find the repeated factor and write it with power 2. Use this constant here; do not copy.

common_errors: uses the previous larger problem instead of this repair skill
expected_solution_steps.diagnostic_sentence: This repair focuses on converting a known repeated factor into square notation, which is needed before spotting a difference of squares.
